reasoning: Shows an upturned open hand with a checkmark above the palm, representing approval, sign-off, acceptance, or a completed handover. It fits common action-focused tasks like approving requests, signing permission slips, handing off work, or accepting deliveries, though at small sizes it can resemble charity or payment (hand-with-coin) icons.
